config.title: Configuration
config.subtitle: Live runtime configuration of the connected agent.
config.patchHint: Saving sends a merge patch — only the keys you changed are applied.
config.notAnObject: The patch must be a JSON object
config.restartHint: Studio cannot kill processes. It sets a flag that Hercules.Supervisor acts on.
config.restartRequested: Restart requested — the supervisor will perform it
config.restartNeedsSystem: Restart requires a system-role session. Reconnect with a system key.
config.keysHint: Keys are stored by the agent and never read back. Each row is a fingerprint; a generated key is shown once and cannot be retrieved again.
config.keyRemoveConfirm: Delete API key {fingerprint}? Active sessions from this key are revoked immediately.
config.keyGeneratedOnce: This key is shown once and is not stored in the browser. Copy it now.
config.keyCopyFailed: Clipboard unavailable — select and copy the key manually
config.quotaHint: Limits live in the agent config; saving applies a merge patch.
config.storageHint: Where sessions, interactions and audit rows are persisted.
config.storageConnectionPlaceholder: leave blank to keep the current one
config.storageConnectionHint: Write-only. The current value is never returned by the agent, and a blank field means "unchanged".
config.storageRestartNotice: Takes effect after a restart — the session store is chosen at startup.
config.storagePartialNotice: The postgres backend is only partially implemented: durable tasks, checkpoints, escalations, sandbox runs and skill evaluations are not supported there yet.
config.storageSaved: Session store configuration saved (applies after restart)
config.storageSaveFailed: Could not save the session store configuration
